justifications.research.methodologyDepth: Curriculum centers on GCP, ICH-E6, FDA regulations, and trial conduct rather than study design, biostatistics, or qualitative methods.
justifications.research.publicationTrack: CCRP holders are typically middle-author trial-operations contributors; certified-coordinator publication rates are modest and rarely first/senior author.
justifications.research.grantReadiness: Provides no formal training in grantsmanship and does not qualify holders for NIH K/F/R or NSF independent awards.
justifications.research.pathwayToIndependence: Designed as a coordinator/associate credential; does not lead to PI status without a separate doctoral degree.
justifications.research.interdisciplinaryFit: Trials span medicine, rehab, nursing, pharma, and devices, giving certified coordinators broad cross-disciplinary exposure.
justifications.research.efficiency: Open to candidates with ~2 years of clinical research experience; single proctored exam (~$285 member fee) with no degree requirement, making it highly accessible.
